Container.Name: JellyPlex-Watched
Container.Overview:
Keeps watched and in-progress state in sync between Plex, Jellyfin and Emby servers, matching items by file name and provider IDs. On first start a sample.config.yaml is copied into the config folder: copy it to config.yaml and edit it (or use the optional web GUI) to add your servers. dryrun is on by default, so nothing is changed until you turn it off.
Optional web GUI: set "Enable web GUI" to true and set a "GUI access token" (required because the GUI listens on all container interfaces). The GUI shows run status, server health, a dry-run plan preview and live logs, and can edit config.yaml, mappings and rules. Keep it on your LAN or behind an HTTPS reverse proxy; the token is sent as a bearer header over plain HTTP otherwise.

Config.Name: Config folder
Config.Description: Holds config.yaml (and the sample). Must be writable if you use the web GUI editor; the GUI also keeps config.yaml.bak-* backups here.

Config.Name: Web GUI port
Config.Description: Port of the optional web GUI (only listens when the GUI is enabled).

Config.Name: Enable web GUI
Config.Description: true serves the dashboard and config editor. Requires the access token below.

Config.Name: GUI access token
Config.Description: Password for the web GUI. Required when the GUI is enabled; the app will not start without it.

Config.Name: GUI listen address
Config.Description: Address the GUI binds to inside the container. Leave as 0.0.0.0 so the mapped port works.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID the app runs as (Unraid default: nobody = 99).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID the app runs as (Unraid default: users = 100).
